section: ER-02 Site conditions and design data
text: Guarantees refer to: ambient dry-bulb temperature 15.0 degC; relative humidity 70 %; barometric pressure 1011.5 mbar; seawater temperature at intake 16.0 degC (contractual reference; the measured annual mean of 15.4 degC in ALP-OWN-MAR-001 applies to the design range only); natural gas per ER-03.02 reference composition; grid frequency 50.0 Hz; power factor 0.85 lagging.
title: Site Reference Conditions (SRC)
